"He past through many repairs and additions, but he,s finally here! Revived by Scrap Tech, this old trade-cargo shuttle now can be purchased by you"
# PREFLIGHT CHECKLIST
## 1. Power supply
## 1.1. Battery units
- Check the substation unit. - Check that the APC unit's Main Breaker is toggled on. - Check the APC unit's current Load* (W).
## 1.2. P.A.C.M.A.N. generator unit
-Check if P.A.C.M.A.N fueled and on
## 2. Atmospherics Atmosphere on shuttle is fully functional and dont have issues
## 2.1. Distribution Loop
-Check if canister is anchored -Check if pump are on
## 2.2. Waste Loop
-Check if pump are on
## 3. Main Machine check
X1 X1 X3 X10
Bootlegger-one of the most fastest shuttle of Frontier, be careful with his speed, cause he slow in spinning around
## 4. Other Checks
Bootlegger store many things for trading and office work-papers, pens, stamps, and other office stuff. Shuttle also contain his own trade bay with withdraw ATM, so you can sell what you salvage for shift.
[color=#FF4500] ## 5. Stored alcohol [/color]
-Check if you have a boots with cow hoof soles -Check if you have tuxedo suit, fedora, and typewriter
